subject: english-literature
title: After the Last Page
welcome_lead: What writers do before, during and after the main story.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on prologues, epilogues and chapter craft.
final_note: You can now identify book-end devices like prologues and epilogues.

concepts.def: Short scene after the main story ends.
A numbered section of a long story.
Single event in one place and time.
Smaller story alongside the main plot.
How the central conflict is settled.

walkthroughs.body_html: An epilogue jumps forward to show 'where they are now'. Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows has a famous '19 years later' epilogue.
A subplot is a smaller storyline. It often deepens theme or character without taking over the main plot.
Conflict can be character vs character, vs self, vs society or vs nature. All four types power great fiction.

mcqs.q: Why are genre conventions important when interpreting a text?
options: They set reader expectations the text can fulfil or subvert; analysing how a text uses or breaks conventions reveals its meaning and significance.
